summary.drained.title: Running on empty
summary.drained.text: High tension, little energy. One small task today is enough — and rest without guilt.
summary.tense.title: Lots of tension
summary.tense.text: You have energy, but it’s tight inside. Find a way to let off steam: a walk, a talk, a few minutes of breathing.
summary.bright.title: A bright day
summary.bright.text: Mood and energy are up. A good moment for what you’ve been putting off.
summary.heavy.title: A heavy day
summary.heavy.text: It happens. Don’t ask much of yourself — notice what gives you even a little support today.
summary.tired.title: Low on energy
summary.tired.text: Your body asks for a pause. Sleep, water and simple things matter more than plans today.
summary.calm.title: A calm day
summary.calm.text: Quiet and steady inside. A fitting day to listen to yourself more closely.
summary.even.title: An even day
summary.even.text: No sharp swings. The hint card will show what to notice today.
